name: 43224 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43224 (Columbus) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43224 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
